english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a person who teaches.
Use this as the all-purpose word for a teacher or instructor.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a teacher at a school.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken term for a teacher or educator.

examples.english: That was my favorite teacher when I was little.
examples.traditional: 我細個最鍾意嗰位老師。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 go2 wai2 lou5 si1

examples.english: This instructor teaches English very clearly.
examples.traditional: 呢位老師教英文教得好清楚。
examples.jyutping: ni1 wai2 lou5 si1 gaau1 jing1 man4 gaau3 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2

examples.english: When I was little, the schoolteacher at my school often taught us how to write.
examples.traditional: 我細個嗰陣，學校老師成日教我哋點樣寫字。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hok6 haau6 lou5 si1 seng4 jat6 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 dim2 joeng2 se2 zi6

examples.english: The educator taught us how to learn wholeheartedly.
examples.traditional: 老師教咗我哋點樣用心學習。
examples.jyutping: lou5 si1 gaau3 zo2 ngo5 dei6 dim2 joeng2 jung6 sam1 hok6 zaap6
